standard_prerequisites.name: Over a perfect field a locally finite type morphism from a reduced scheme with free sheaf of differentials is smooth (Varieties chapter, Lemma varieties-lemma-char-p-differentials-free-smooth, canonical tag 04QP)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns freeness of the differentials, reducedness of R and local finite type into smoothness of s and t.

core_obligations: By lemma-sheaf-differentials (applicable by assumptions (1) and (2)) the sheaf Omega_{R/U} of the morphism R to U is free. Assumption (3) says R is reduced and assumption (4) says k is perfect, so varieties-lemma-char-p-differentials-free-smooth applies to the locally finite type morphism R to U from the reduced scheme R with free sheaf of differentials and gives that R to U is smooth. Conclusion: both s and t are smooth.
proof_roadmap: Get freeness of Omega_{R/U} from lemma-sheaf-differentials (proof lines 1652-1654).
Apply the perfect field reduced case smoothness criterion to the locally finite type morphism R to U (proof lines 1654-1655).
